facts.detail: The November 2025 page was updated on 20 July 2026.
The table is a snapshot of data held on 17 November 2025.
BDUK publishes monthly contract-level progress information.
Initial scope is counted and deferred scope may be absent.
The figures are not directly comparable with official statistics.
A variable data-ingestion lag is recorded.
The figures are rounded to the nearest ten.
The November table totals 1,002,210 contracted and 167,770 built premises.
Cumbria is listed with 53,540 contracted and 24,270 built premises.
North Shropshire is listed with 3,410 contracted and 3,410 built premises.

facts.detail: Ofcom reports submissions from 52 fixed-network and 18 FWA providers.
The fixed-coverage data was collected as a January 2026 snapshot.
Providers submitted records for premises where an end-user could order a fixed broadband service on their network.
Ofcom used AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 123 for the premises base.
The documentation says the data is provided under the Open Government Licence.
Version 2 is dated 7 July 2026.
Ofcom records that the CW postcode-area file had duplicated CV and was corrected.
Ofcom records that the MK postcode-area file had duplicated ME and was corrected.
All 121 all-premises postcode files were renamed from r1 to r2.
The documentation lists 1,741,096 rows across the all-premises postcode files.
